principle: Never leave SLOT_01 through SLOT_05 idle while SLOT_06 integrates the preceding wave, when the next wave source packages and prompts already exist.
allowed_overlap: Wave N SLOT 06 integration may run concurrently with Wave N+1 SLOT 01-05 read-only classification.
Wave N+1 worker results may be published before Wave N closure.
Wave N+1 promotion, canonical selection, integrated closure, Ready, Merge, or runtime authority must wait for the applicable gate.
forbidden: official reusable-source promotion before integration gate

handoff_rule.when_slot06_finishes_wave_n: DO_NOT_RESTART_IDLE_WORKERS; preserve ongoing Wave N+1 work

target_utilization.exception: A slot may be idle only when its next package is unavailable, a safety gate specifically blocks read-only classification, or a material blocker is evidenced.
